Latest gum disease treatment kills bad bacteria while sparing the good

📅 23 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 6 min read (1156 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Sciencedaily

⏱️ ~6 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Researchers in Japan have developed a promising newly introduced treatment for gum disease that kills harmful bacteria while leaving beneficial microbes unharmed.
  • In a recent development, developed by scientists at Nagoya University, the treatment combines antibodies obtained from egg yolks with near-infrared light.
  • Why Conventional Gum Disease Treatments Can Cause Problems.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Researchers in Japan have developed a promising newly introduced treatment for gum disease that kills harmful bacteria while leaving beneficial microbes unharmed. Unlike conventional approaches that can eliminate both good and bad bacteria, the new therapy is designed to target specific microbes responsible for damaging gums and the bone that supports teeth.

In a recent development, developed by scientists at Nagoya University, the treatment combines antibodies obtained from egg yolks with near-infrared light. Early experiments in human cell cultures and mice suggest that it could offer a more precise way to combat periodontitis, a serious form of gum disease that can eventually lead to tooth loss. The findings were published in the Journal of Translational Medicine.

Why Conventional Gum Disease Treatments Can Cause Problems.

The human mouth contains a complex community of microorganisms, many of which play important roles in maintaining oral health. Problems can arise when harmful bacteria multiply and disturb this delicate balance.

One particularly troublesome species is Porphyromonas gingivalis (P. gingivalis), which scientists classify as a keystone pathogen. This means it can have an outsized influence on the surrounding microbial community, even when it is not especially abundant. By promoting inflammation and disrupting the normal balance of oral bacteria, it can contribute to the destruction of the bone that holds teeth in place.

Treating periodontitis often involves eliminating the bacteria responsible for the infection. However, some existing antimicrobial treatments do not distinguish between harmful organisms and microbes that help maintain a healthy mouth.

Sources indicate that "Current treatments for periodontitis, including antibiotics and antimicrobial photodynamic therapy (aPDT), eliminate both pathogenic and beneficial oral bacteria," remarked Kazuhide Sato, one of the corresponding authors and a lecturer at Nagoya University. "These approaches often disrupt the entire oral microbial ecosystem and can also release lipopolysaccharide (LPS), an endotoxin that may exacerbate inflammation.".

Scientists Adapt Cancer Therapy to Target Gum Disease Bacteria.

Sources indicate that to overcome these limitations, the Nagoya University team turned to a technology originally designed to treat cancer. Known as near-infrared photoimmunotherapy, it uses antibodies linked to a light-sensitive dye to recognize specific targets. Once the compound attaches to its intended target, exposure to near-infrared light activates the dye and produces a damaging effect.

The researchers adapted this strategy to attack P. gingivalis without unnecessarily disturbing other oral bacteria. Their approach relies on IgY, a type of antibody collected from the egg yolks of hens that have been immunized against the pathogen.

Sources indicate that egg yolk antibodies offer a practical advantage because they can be produced in large quantities at relatively low cost. This could make them an attractive option for developing targeted treatments that are affordable and scalable.

The resulting technology, called near-infrared photo-antibacterial targeting therapy (NIR-PAT²), was developed by researchers at Nagoya University Graduate School of Medicine. The team included first author Hiroshi Maruyama, Professor Hideharu Hibi, and corresponding authors Sato and Kiyoshi Sakai.

Sources indicate that to determine whether the treatment could destroy harmful bacteria while protecting healthy tissue, the researchers tested it in human cell cultures and mice. They also compared its effects with those of conventional antimicrobial therapies.

Light-Activated Antibodies Destroy Harmful Bacteria.

Industry observers note that laboratory experiments indicated that the antibody and dye combination attached specifically to P. gingivalis. Other bacterial species and healthy human gum cells were left unaffected.

When the researchers illuminated the targeted bacteria with near-infrared light, the activated dye damaged their outer membranes, ultimately killing them.

Microscopic examination revealed an crucial difference between this technique and conventional antimicrobial light therapy. Bacteria exposed to the new treatment developed tiny openings in their membranes but largely maintained their overall shape. By contrast, conventional antimicrobial photodynamic therapy caused the bacteria to break apart completely.

Sources indicate that the distinction matters because destroying bacterial cells can release substances that contribute to inflammation. Preserving the overall structure of the targeted bacteria, even after killing them, could help limit this unwanted effect.

The researchers also examined how the treatments affected healthy human gum cells. Their targeted therapy caused no detectable harm to these cells, while conventional antimicrobial photodynamic therapy produced cellular damage and slowed healing.

Latest Treatment Reduces Bone Loss in Mice.

The team next investigated whether these laboratory findings would translate into meaningful improvements in gum disease.

Industry observers note that in mice with periodontitis, the experimental therapy significantly reduced the loss of alveolar bone, the part of the jawbone that surrounds and supports teeth. Preventing this type of bone deterioration is especially important because advanced periodontitis can loosen teeth and eventually cause them to fall out.

Sources indicate that analysis of the animals' saliva revealed another encouraging result. The treatment reduced P. gingivalis while preserving beneficial Streptococcus bacteria, helping maintain a healthier balance of microorganisms in the mouth.

Conventional antibiotics and antimicrobial photodynamic therapy, on the other hand, eliminated both harmful and beneficial bacteria in the experiments, causing broader disruption to the oral microbial community.

"Results demonstrated that, unlike antibiotics or standard light therapy, this approach selectively removes the primary pathogenic species while preserving the remainder of the oral bacterial community," Sato stated.

Together, the findings suggest that targeting individual disease-causing bacteria could help control gum disease while avoiding some of the unintended consequences of broader antimicrobial treatments.

AI Could Help Develop More Precise Gum Disease Treatments.

Although the early results are promising, the researchers recognize that periodontitis is a complex disease involving multiple bacterial species. Eliminating P. gingivalis alone may not be sufficient to treat every case.

To address this challenge, the team intends to use artificial intelligence (AI) to examine publicly available information about oral bacteria. By identifying other important microorganisms and studying how different species interact, they hope to uncover additional targets for future therapies.

It has been revealed that the researchers also see potential implications beyond oral health. Periodontitis has been linked to several other medical conditions, including rheumatoid arthritis and diabetes.

According to recent reports, understanding the relationships between oral bacteria and these conditions could eventually help scientists identify which patients are most likely to benefit from specific treatments. AI analysis may play a role in making those decisions and guiding the development of more personalized approaches to gum disease.

Recent findings suggest that for now, the therapy remains experimental, with its effectiveness demonstrated in laboratory studies and mice rather than human clinical trials. However, the findings point toward a possible future in which treating gum disease means selectively removing harmful bacteria instead of disrupting the entire microbial community that helps keep the mouth healthy.

The idea of descending into the depths of the unknown is already terrifying as it is, but in Sol Cesto, you're doing so because the sun has mysteriously disappeared - and all manner of unholy creatures have taken over because of it.

Recent findings suggest that I've always been a fan of roguelikes, so the genre alone already scores points in my book. But I suppose what makes Sol Cesto even more interesting are the visuals - in some ways, it reminds me of this Burton-esque puzzler, Jars, with its creepy-but-cute charm.

Industry observers note that the haunting music adds to the atmosphere, so if you're looking for horror-adjacent roguelike runs before rushing into December, this might just do the trick. So, how do you play Sol Cesto? It's currently got that "early access" tag on Google Play, but I'm curious as to what else Snapbreak is cooking up behind the scenes before this is officially debuted. It's all pretty hush-hush at the moment, though, so if you want to get your hands on Sol Cesto before it's actually declared, now's your chance!

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Sources indicate that earlier this very month, Jensen Huang, CEO of the world’s leading chip producer, Nvidia, not to mention one of the most crucial companies to the advancement of gaming as a creator of GPUs, was wracked with controversy. Huang admitted an affair with a woman alleged to be a spy for the Chinese government and was also accused of an affair with an Nvidia executive, according to the BBC.

In a recent development, following all of these revelations, Huang voluntarily resigned from his position as CEO. For a brief, glorious moment, the gaming community breathed a sigh of relief, as it was Huang’s gung-ho attitude on AI-centric developments over all else that had largely contributed to Nvidia shifting focus away from gaming hardware. Maybe we’d start seeing affordable, optimized GPUs again!

Unfortunately, we are not allowed to have nice things in this timeline. According to a BBC report this morning, following a unanimous vote from the current Nvidia corporate board, Huang has been officially reinstated to his position as CEO. Yay.

According to the BBC report, despite previous insistences from the board that Huang would not be reinstated to his position, the ultimate conclusion that they came to is that only Huang could continue the AI-focused push Nvidia has been running with lately.

"The board believes Jensen is the right person to lead Nvidia, and that his reinstatement is in the best interests of our stockholders, employees, partners and customers," the board’s current chair said in a public statement on the Nvidia website.

The ultimate conclusion that they came to is that only Huang could continue the AI-focused push Nvidia has been running with lately.

Apparently, Huang’s return was orchestrated at least in part by United States President Donald Trump, who, in a brief interview with CNBC, stated that he “felt very strongly that [Huang] should come back, and we've done a very thorough investigation.

"And the investigation showed that he did - I mean, he had bad judgment having to do with somewhat unrelated incidents - but he did nothing wrong other than he created a chip that's invaluable.".

Following news of Huang’s reinstatement, Nvidia’s stock value bounced up 32%, a notable increase following a 13% drop-off at the end of last week.

In a personal statement on the Nvidia website, Huang remarked that he is “honoured to return to Nvidia and lead one of the most consequential technology companies in the world at the beginning of a newly introduced industrial revolution.

“I take this responsibility with the greatest humility and renewed commitment.”.

Recent findings suggest that some analysts speculate that, particularly within the AI-centric tech field, figureheads have become an vital part of the push. Parallels have been drawn between Huang’s reinstatement and that of OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, who was reinstated in his own position just five days after being fired from it in 2023.

The BBC’s tech and AI analyst Zoe Kleinman posited on the matter, saying that “It claims a lot that despite the serious accusations made about him and his affair with a woman accused of being a Chinese spy, ultimately his position in the tech industry has proved to be more notable:.

“There had been many calls for him to be reinstated - including from within the UK House of Lords - on the grounds that the AI industry would be weaker without him.”.

Industry observers note that whatever the precise reason, it’s probably a safe bet that Nvidia will promptly resume its previous course, which means those of us in the gaming sphere won’t be seeing any affordable GPUs any time soon. Oh well, it was nice to dream of a world where you didn't need to justify buying a top-shelf graphics card...

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

After a couple of delays, a plagiarism lawsuit, and at least one internal reboot, Bungie’s next massive game has officially introduced. Marathon, the extraction shooter from the studio behind Destiny, has managed to find a decent, if a little small of an audience.

The game’s player numbers on Steam are being compared to its recent free, open weekend, and not in a favourable manner.

Prior to Marathon’s launch, Bungie held a multi-day Server Slam, which offered anyone interested in playing the game a chance to try out almost all of its classes, two of its maps, as well as many of its gameplay and progression systems.

The open test was largely well-received, and players actually indicated up for it. It peaked at a very respectable 143,621 concurrent players on Steam, which put it within striking distance of the peak concurrent of its chief competitor, Arc Raiders - at least when you compare both of their pre-launch Server Slam events.

Recent findings suggest that in Arc Raiders’ case, those figures were far outpaced at the game’s actual launch, and the Embark shooter continues to command a very active player base to this day. A paid product garnering far more players than the same product’s own free sampler is never not a good sign, so many hoped something similar would happen with Marathon.

In a recent development, marathon has now officially debuted, and it doesn’t look like it managed to pull an Arc Raiders - at least so far. At its peak, the Bungie shooter attracted 88,337 concurrent players on Steam (via SteamDB), which is a little over half of its Server Slam’s 143,621 peak concurrent.

Sources indicate that numbers have, of course, dropped since then, which is normal, as players log off for the night. This is obviously not the end of the road for Marathon. Friday, and the weekend, may well push numbers closer to the Server Slam heights.

Industry observers note that indeed, word of mouth is quite positive, with the game currently sitting at a Very Positive user review rating on Steam, based on over 4,600 reviews. As has been proven time and time again in recent years, nothing catapults a game like players emphatically advocating for it to their friends, so it could simply be that mainstream players are cautious.

It will become clear where things settle over the weekend.

IBM quantum computer solves problem classical computers can’t in just 15 minutes

📅 24 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 5 min read (982 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Sciencedaily

⏱️ ~5 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Sources indicate that an IBM quantum computer has completed an extraordinarily complex computational task in just 15 minutes, while leading methods for simulating the calculation on conventional computers would require prohibitively long runtimes.
  • Sources indicate that the achievement, led by IBM and researchers from the University of Chicago, satisfies the fundamental criteria for quantum advantage.
  • In their new paper, "Sampling hard circuits with verifiably high fidelity," the researchers demonstrated that both objectives could be achieved simultaneously using a novel design for encoded quantum circuits.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Sources indicate that an IBM quantum computer has completed an extraordinarily complex computational task in just 15 minutes, while leading methods for simulating the calculation on conventional computers would require prohibitively long runtimes. Perhaps even more significantly, researchers were able to establish statistical confidence in the accuracy of the quantum computer's results, addressing one of the biggest obstacles in the field.

Sources indicate that the achievement, led by IBM and researchers from the University of Chicago, satisfies the fundamental criteria for quantum advantage. This milestone occurs when a quantum computer performs a computational task beyond the practical capabilities of leading classical computing methods while producing results that can be trusted.

In their new paper, "Sampling hard circuits with verifiably high fidelity," the researchers demonstrated that both objectives could be achieved simultaneously using a novel design for encoded quantum circuits. The experiment represents one of the largest demonstrations of logical quantum computing to date. The researchers have also made their circuits and experimental results publicly available through the Quantum Advantage Tracker.

Solving Quantum Computing's Verification Problem.

It has been revealed that unlike conventional computers, which process information using bits that represent either zero or one, quantum computers rely on quantum bits, or qubits. These can exist in combinations of both states and interact through a phenomenon known as quantum entanglement. These properties allow quantum computers to approach certain computational problems in fundamentally different ways.

For years, scientists have tested the capabilities of quantum computers using a benchmark called random circuit sampling (RCS). This technique involves running a series of randomly selected quantum operations and generating samples from a complex probability distribution. As the circuits grow larger and more complicated, reproducing their output with a classical computer becomes increasingly difficult.

However, this approach creates a fundamental dilemma. If a computation is too difficult for a classical computer to reproduce, how can researchers establish that the quantum computer performed it correctly?

As computational complexity increases, independently verifying the results becomes progressively more difficult and eventually impractical without making strong assumptions about how accurately the quantum hardware operates.

Sources indicate that to overcome this problem, the IBM and University of Chicago team developed a more structured alternative to random circuit sampling. The researchers mathematically demonstrated that their approach preserves the same computational hardness criteria as conventional RCS while introducing a structure that allows errors to be detected during the computation.

"Verification remains one of the biggest challenges in firmly establishing experimental quantum advantage," noted Bill Fefferman, Associate Professor at the University of Chicago. "This experiment develops techniques to better characterize the fidelity of hard quantum states under noise, increasing confidence that the quantum computer is solving a computationally hard problem.".

Soumik Ghosh, PhD student in Fefferman's group at the University of Chicago, added, "Beyond strengthening experimental validation, advances in verification have the potential to unlock practical applications for the next generation of quantum computers.".

70 Logical Qubits and Tenfold Lower Error Rates.

One of the greatest challenges in building powerful quantum computers is their extraordinary sensitivity to errors. Quantum information can be disrupted by environmental disturbances, imperfections in hardware, and inaccuracies in the operations used to manipulate qubits. As computations become longer and more complex, these errors can accumulate and undermine the reliability of the results.

Quantum error correction addresses this weakness by encoding quantum information across multiple physical qubits to create more reliable units known as logical qubits. This approach allows certain errors to be identified and, depending on the technique, corrected or accounted for without destroying the underlying quantum information.

In one of the largest known demonstrations of quantum error correction, the researchers performed computations using 70 protected logical qubits. The experiment involved 2,415 logical two-qubit operations and 468 logical "T gates.".

Quantum gates are the fundamental operations that manipulate quantum information, much like logic gates in conventional computers. Two-qubit gates allow qubits to interact, while T gates enable additional types of quantum operations needed for universal quantum computing. Together, these gate counts illustrate the considerable complexity of the experiment.

By encoding the quantum circuits, the researchers achieved effective logical error rates 10 times lower than the underlying physical error rates. This substantial reduction allowed the quantum computer to maintain remarkably high fidelity, a measure of how closely the actual quantum state matches the intended one, despite performing thousands of complex operations.

In a recent development, "We are now firmly in the quantum advantage era," mentioned Jay Gambetta, Director of IBM Research and IBM Fellow. "We have demonstrated a quantum computation beyond the practical reach of classical computers that establishes, with statistical confidence, a lower bound on how faithfully it was executed. This milestone gives scientists, developers, and businesses a upcoming foundation for trusting quantum computers as they scale to problems far beyond what we can achieve classically.".

The researchers found that many leading classical simulation techniques would require impractically long periods to reproduce the computation. IBM's quantum computer, by comparison, accomplished the task in approximately 15 minutes.

Although the experiment was designed to demonstrate quantum advantage rather than solve an immediate real-world problem, it addresses two essential requirements for making large-scale quantum computing practical: controlling errors and establishing confidence in computational results.

By demonstrating both capabilities in a computation beyond the practical reach of leading classical methods, the researchers have taken a significant step toward a future in which quantum computers could reliably tackle scientific and industrial problems that are right now out of reach.

Marvel Cosmic Invasion's Doctor Doom-Themed DLC Gives It The Post-Game Tail It Was Missing

📅 10 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 4 min read (845 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Gameinformer

⏱️ ~4 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Industry observers note that marvel Cosmic Invasion was a bit of a dream game for me; I loved the X-Men arcade game in the '90s, so when Tribute Games released the excellent Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Shredder's Revenge in 2022, I immediately hoped they'd revitalize other licensed brawler franchises released by Konami in the late '80s and early '90s.
  • I played through Marvel Cosmic Invasion multiple times and had a blast, but I moved on swiftly, as I didn't feel the need to collect different palette-swaps of the many heroes on offer.
  • Industry observers note that seeing that Annihilus is threatening the universe, Doom decides to take matters into his own hands.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Industry observers note that marvel Cosmic Invasion was a bit of a dream game for me; I loved the X-Men arcade game in the '90s, so when Tribute Games released the excellent Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Shredder's Revenge in 2022, I immediately hoped they'd revitalize other licensed brawler franchises released by Konami in the late '80s and early '90s. While we still haven't heard any word of a latest brawler starring The Simpsons, Tribute did follow up its Turtle triumph with Marvel Cosmic Invasion, another throwback side-scrolling beat 'em up, this time starring Marvel's mightiest.

I played through Marvel Cosmic Invasion multiple times and had a blast, but I moved on swiftly, as I didn't feel the need to collect different palette-swaps of the many heroes on offer. Even after Cyclops and The Thing joined the roster as DLC in May, I still saw Cosmic Invasion as a game in the rearview. That changes this week, as The Siege of Castle Doom not only adds two additional playable characters (Invisible Woman and Doctor Doom), but also a mode that has the potential to bring me back for more runs for the foreseeable future.

Industry observers note that seeing that Annihilus is threatening the universe, Doom decides to take matters into his own hands. Unfortunately, much in the way that it seems that he may try to fix the multiversal incursions in the upcoming Avengers: Doomsday, Victor Von Doom's solution in Marvel Cosmic Invasion – the Cosmic Inductor – would lead to untold death and destruction. In The Siege of Castle Doom, you select your team and fight your way through various floors of the stronghold belonging to the man who is perhaps Marvel's greatest villain. Your goal is to fight through the winding, randomized hallways of Castle Doomstadt, charging Reed Richards' Stabilizer and tactically bolstering your team along the way, before Doctor Doom can enact his initiative.

Recent findings suggest that as for the new playable characters, Doctor Doom is less agile, but his attacks pack a whallop, while Invisible Woman's force fields and speed make her the more versatile pick. I don't know that I see either of them replacing my mains from the base game, but I had fun experimenting with them throughout this mode. Regardless of which character you choose from the expanding roster, you still must traverse Castle Doomstadt before Doom achieves his objective.

Fighting through waves of enemies across differently themed and booby-trapped rooms, you encounter all manner of foes from the base game, as well as new minion types from Doom. When you defeat enemies, they drop batteries that charge your Stabilizer, letting you even the odds and stop Doom. Conversely, each time an enemy hits your character, it charges Doom's Cosmic Inductor, inching him closer to victory and making his minions faster and stronger in the process. As you might expect, the rooms get harder the deeper you go, and while each player starts with two characters to swap between, if a character completely depletes their health, they're gone for good, making it even tougher. As such, you need to keep your eyes on each character's health and swap them out when it makes sense.

As you complete each room, you can choose which path to take to augment your characters with newly introduced special abilities. True to the roguelite structure, as you complete rooms, you can also buff your characters' stats within the run. Certain rooms offer extra batteries to help your Stabilizer charge, while others offer new and upgraded equipment. There's also one that promises random events that can easily alter the trajectory of your run for better or worse. Though I often enjoyed boosting attack stats to make enemies less like damage sponges, I had to balance that against buffing their health to keep them alive and charging the Stabilizer to have a fighting chance.

Industry observers note that beyond the in-run upgrades and modifiers, you can also amp up the action run-over-run through upgrades in Reed's Lab, which add to the pool of modifiers you can select from at the start of each run. The expansion also adds new palettes for existing heroes, plus new music by composer Tee Lopes. While I've only done a few runs of The Siege of Castle Doom (each taking between 45 and 90 minutes, depending on how successful you are), I feel a revitalized sense of excitement for Marvel Cosmic Invasion. Tribute claims completionists can spend upwards of 15 hours in this new mode, which has me champing at the bit to dive back into what will likely be my primary way of interacting with Marvel Cosmic Invasion going forward.

It has been revealed that marvel Cosmic Invasion – The Siege of Castle Doom is available today on all platforms, and it is a strong addition to an already great game. You can read our review of the base version of Marvel Cosmic Invasion here.

It has been revealed that bad signal or dead zones? Download your complications before you leave and read anywhere.

📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Team Ninja continues to work on Nioh 3.
  • Today’s patch, version 1.04, is a major one, coming in at well over 1GB.
  • Industry observers note that to begin with, this is the patch that adds the promised free armour sets for both Ninja, and Samurai.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Team Ninja continues to work on Nioh 3. The developer has been releasing regular updates for the action RPG since its launch in early February. Earlier patches have addressed major bugs like healing item use inconsistencies, and more have arrived since to tackle various balance and loot-related issues.

Today’s patch, version 1.04, is a major one, coming in at well over 1GB. There’s plenty here worth getting excited about, so let’s dig in.

Industry observers note that to begin with, this is the patch that adds the promised free armour sets for both Ninja, and Samurai. When Nioh 3 reached one million sales, Team Ninja remarked it would gift every player the Thunderous set in celebration, and the set’s two variants are now available in-game.

Sources indicate that the more interesting side of the patch is, unsurprisingly, its change log. There appears to be a focus on online co-op and AI summons in this one, with various tweaks to the make the process more rewarding, and, in some cases, worthwhile.

It has been revealed that the amount of Glory obtained when you complete a mission in multiplayer has been increased, regardless of which player was the host. The other major change mainly affects AI Benevolent Grave summons, making it so bosses will no longer target a single player for almost the entirety of the fight.

While summoning AI helpers has always been useful in Nioh 3, they didn’t always help in boss fights, specifically because the boss tended to focus on the player who summoned them, leaving the AI to run around eating AoE hits before dying.

According to recent reports, patch 1.04 makes a couple of welcome gameplay tweaks to the feel of combat. Ninjutsu, and Onmyo Magic will now hit their targets more consistently in situations where there’s a difference in elevation between the player and the enemy.

In a recent development, in the same vein, you’ll now be able to attack (quick/strong) right after jumping, which removes the pause that previously buffered the attack instead. This could mean even more air combos that don’t specifically require Martial Arts.

You can look forward to a couple of quality of life tweaks in this patch, too, such as the change that allows the game to automatically send any Sudama Soul Cores dropped by merchants to your item box. This happens from the second one onwards, which means you won’t have to pick half a dozen each time you go to sell a batch of items.

Speaking of the item box, the limit of forging materials has been increased for some of them. If you’ve been running Battle Scroll missions and Expeditions for gear, you’ll be happy to know that you can now exit the session from the main menu directly.

There’s plenty more to patch 1.04, including fixes and balance tweaks for several weapons, such as Samurai dual swords, odachi, and more for a few Ninja weapons, too. The patch also brings several bug fixes to the game.

You can read the full set of patch notes on Steam.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Industry observers note that the Sims 4 will soon get a newly introduced revision to resolve a number of issues, some of which have long caused headaches for players. The latest update will arrive March 17 on PC and Mac, followed by PlayStation and Xbox at an unspecified time later.

Outside of the fixes themselves, the patch also makes good on the recent re-commitment to continue improving quality of life for players, so there’s plenty here longtime players will appreciate.

In the latest episode of The Sims 4’s Laundry List blog series, where the developer goes through the most reported problems with the game and how it looks to solve them, we got a rundown of what to expect from next week’s patch.

You can look forward to five major fixes in this one, but arguably the most important is a change to how Sims determine who they speak with on a lot. This is especially relevant for public lots, where Sims would sometimes interrupt ongoing conversations by barging in and starting a conversation with your Sim.

It has been revealed that going forward, Sims will prioritise familiar Sims with whom they already have rapport, and be less likely to latch onto strangers. If you’ve witnessed a date your Sim was on get interrupted because of that, you’ll certainly appreciate the change.

Sources indicate that speaking of budding romance, Prom is coming back to in-game Calendars, and Sims can once again attend. Maxis stated this will work with new and existing saves, and that you should also expect Prom goals to be completable once again.

It has been revealed that pets and animals get some love in this patch, too. First, pets and horses will no longer get lost in Premade Households. The fix prevents that from happening in fresh saves, but if you already had that happen to you in your current save, it’ll still be there.

In a recent development, you may now also assign animals to an Animal Shed after moving your house to a upcoming lot, so you hopefully won’t be confused as to why they’re stuck in your inventory. This fix applies to existing saves as well as new ones.

Lower down the list of urgent fixes is an patch that makes it so Sims’ eye blinking will show fully closed eyes for most interactions. The upcoming patch also comes with a host of Sims autonomy fixes, including one that prevents them from excessively flirting with each other.

Industry observers note that catch up on the full list at the link near the top of the page. And, in case you missed it, Maxis recently announced that The Sims 4 will soon get paid mods, something that many in the community are skeptical about.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Escape the Baby Alarm has its own charm, from the moment you see the graphics that come with it. This narrative-driven puzzler is all about becoming a parent, losing yourself, being exhausted, and trying to find your own way to heal. The gameplay is a mix of almost comic book-like stories to scroll through and puzzles that make sense if you look around for a bit.

Many of these moments are very relatable if you have ever had a baby. Organising your baby's items, trying to make a mobile, cleaning your house. There are lots of moments that show the frame of mind of a newborn. Some honest panels of struggling to believe in yourself. Moments of needing to clean your house so that you can then watch over your baby. There's even a sort of boss fight full of puzzles where you are trying to defeat your own self-doubt.

Industry observers note that it's a very interesting game, full of colour, and the various puzzles are really well thought out. Each of the puzzles does have three hints as well as a screenshot that highlights you the answer, if you do get stuck. There aren't often timers, but there is sometimes someone who will knock out the things that you've done, so you need to put them back in. The puzzles have a nice variety and flow to them.

Industry observers note that I found the little storybook elements of the game to be lovely too; some of them feel very empowering. There is a lot of content in Escape the Baby Alarm - from the puzzles to the chapters to little diary entries that are written by the developer, really showing personal moments and their own feelings when it comes to the birth of their baby. This very much feels like fumbling through someone's diary!

Escape the Baby Alarm is all about discovering who you are after having a baby, finding your own voice, and making sure that you are reflecting on your own self as well, so that you can be the best version of yourself. It's trippy, in the best sort of way, and really draws you in.

It has been revealed that download now! Escape the Baby Alarm.

According to recent reports, space, the final frontier. And like all frontiers, there's always someone willing to take a chance on building a latest life there, no matter how much of a ludicrously ill-advised idea it may be. It's a concept that offers rich ground for colony management sims, but there haven't been many options for that on mobile, well, until Ember Outpost arrived.

Sources indicate that available now on iOS and Android, Ember Outpost is a colony management sim that sees you guiding a group of settlers on an alien world. Everything, from food to water and other supplies, will need to be crafted or collected, and you'll also have to deal with the drastically contradictory personalities of your colonists. Oh, and let's add natural disasters and murderous raiders, just for some extra spice.

It has been revealed that it's not all sunshine and roses, though. Ember Outpost does have the lingering spectre of AI in some bizarrely high-res assets scattered throughout, and promotional imagery. Which is a shame because I think part of the appeal of colony sims such as RimWorld is how easily readable and minimalist they are. But you can't have everything.

Sources indicate that for what it is, Ember Outpost offers exactly what those who want RimWorld on mobile have been waiting for. Densely detailed colony sim action, where there's just as much potential for disasters inside the walls of your compound as outside of it.

But Gunboat God, now available on iOS and Android, may just prove that the bullet hell genre isn't dead by a long shot!

Gunboat God is an inky black-and-white take on the bullet hell and shoot-em-up genre, where your only aim is to slay as many enemies as possible and make your way back to the Citadel in the sky. Along the way, you'll fly into the air, dive beneath the waves and skirt along the surface, blasting foes to bits as you go.

Gunboat God isn't a simple arcade format either, as you'll gradually make your way through a variety of levels, beat down towering bosses and get your upcoming friend Yeti the crocodile (confusing, I know) to help rebuild your boat.

Sources indicate that gunboat God is blisteringly fast-paced, exciting and difficult, but rewardingly so. And with such a distinctive art-style which really makes it stand out even if the action can get a bit hard to follow. Either way you certainly won't be forgetting this distinctive mashup of platformer, bullet hell and run 'n gun anytime soon!

Crimson Desert PC specs don't keep resolution and framerate targets a secret, and they don't use upscaling for everything either

📅 11 Mar 2026 | ⏱️ 2 min read (402 words, 📖 Standard) | Source: Vg247

⏱️ ~2 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Crimson Desert is a little over one week away from release, and developer Pearl Abyss has delivered the official, final list of specs for the game.
  • The specs are decently detailed, but more surprisingly - except for a single instance - they don’t include upscaling on PC, another thing games have gotten too comfortable using, even with their lowest specs.
  • On the official Crimson Desert website, developer Pearl Abyss has delivered a chunky post breaking down five different sets of PC requirements for the upcoming open-world action RPG.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Crimson Desert is a little over one week away from release, and developer Pearl Abyss has delivered the official, final list of specs for the game. The twist is that the specs not only include useful information for PC players, they also cover similarly relevant details for console players, who traditionally don’t get mentioned in those reveals.

The specs are decently detailed, but more surprisingly - except for a single instance - they don’t include upscaling on PC, another thing games have gotten too comfortable using, even with their lowest specs.

On the official Crimson Desert website, developer Pearl Abyss has delivered a chunky post breaking down five different sets of PC requirements for the upcoming open-world action RPG. Each set indicates the graphics preset being used - and crucially, the resolution and framerate targets you can expect with each.

In a recent development, with the exception of the Minimum spec, all other presets do not appear to rely on upscaling of any kind. They do not say, however, whether ray tracing is being used with any of them, which is a feature that will throw all of those specs out of whack.

That same transparency also extends to non-PC platforms, which traditionally get few, if any, details about their own resolution and framerate targets. The console set of specs are extensive, just like PC, covering both PlayStation, and Xbox.

In a recent development, it’s granular enough to indicate which upscaling tech is being used, where applicable. This is relevant for owners of a PS5 Pro, a console that has access to Sony’s PSSR upscaling, alongside the standard AMD FSR tech the base console - and Xbox - use.

The developer has also revealed the base resolution for each mode across each console, and the resolution the image will be upscaled to using whichever tech is being utilised.

According to recent reports, and, if you’re one of the five people who play games on Mac, you’ll be thrilled to know that the specs also include a section for Mac devices, split between the different Mac chips. The quality preset being used with each is not clear, however.

Finally, there's a set of specs for the Rog Xbox Ally, covering both the X and S models.

Crimson Desert arrives March 20 on PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X/S. You can expect more coverage from us at release and beyond.

Yes, I personally think GTA 6's Ultimate Edition is worth it, but it really depends how excited you are for the game and whether you want to get the most out of it.

All of the additional Mod Shops and Stores exclusive to the Ultimate Edition, along with their unique inventory, means you're really adding a lot of cosmetic and personalisation options to the title with the Ultimate Edition.

You can still enjoy GTA 6 to its fullest without paying for the Ultimate Edition, but you'll get much more out of the game if you do.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+ was one of a handful of games brave enough to launch on 'GTA Day' last week, but while Rockstar has been swimming in positive reception ever since, Isaac's re-release hasn't been so lucky.

Indeed, the game has been subject to a hefty review bombing from players on Steam after it was discovered that AI-generated music was used in the release's fresh GTA 6-themed online mode (thanks for the heads up, Steam Hype).

A post on the game's Reddit page by user ShweetsStuff alerted players to mentions of the AI music 'tool' Suno in select tracks' metadata, pointing out that no AI disclosure was given on its Steam page (a requirement these days).

As you might expect, players weren't all that happy to learn of the AI usage. At the time of writing, the game's ~1,800 recent reviews lean heavily into the platform's 'Overwhelmingly Negative' camp.

Even the game's original creator, Edmund McMillen, was shocked to learn of the Suno involvement in the game, taking to X to share the following message:.

Woke up to a s**t show, obviously I had no idea it featured generated music in the daily run, looking into how that happened and getting it removed, stay tuned.

It has been revealed that all fingers point towards publisher Nicalis on this one, then (a organization with hardly the best track record when it comes to the treatment of its staff). The studio has since issued a patch on Steam — without any kind of apology, we should add — which removes the GenAI tracks, though it will naturally take longer to make its way to consoles.

According to recent reports, have you already checked out Repentance+ on Switch? Does this put you off doing so? Let us know in the comments.

[source reddit.com, via steamhype.com].

When it comes to 'classy' party games, I'd be hard-pressed to think of any. By their very nature, most party games are lighthearted and fun, but that's where Suits & Stallions comes in: a upcoming entry in the genre available now on iOS and Android that leans into the classier side of the equation.

What's the classiest thing you can imagine? Horse racing, of course! And that's what Suits & Stallions is all about, as you race your porcelain model horses across a board in a classily lit museum setting. Each card you draw can move either you, your opponent or both, depending on the corresponding suit, but you can try to nudge the results or whip your chosen stallion into shape for a better chance at success.

Recent findings suggest that there are also other optional modes, such as Troika, which sees you racing an entire tower of horses rather than one. And the best part is that if you stay playing against the PC, then all of this is free!

Industry observers note that of course, the main appeal of any party game is playing with your friends, and in that regard Suits & Stallions is an interesting example of the genre. Less likely to cause pure chaos, but I can see a devious card draw and decision to send your friend back causing plenty of lighthearted arguments.

In a recent development, you can find Suits & Stallions right now on iOS and Android. But if you're looking for even more free-to-play games, then mobile is definitely the place to be. Just take a look at our list of the best free mobile games of 2026 for some of our choice picks!

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

QoR's 2-0 win over Maryville University completed a recovery from an opening defeat at the VCT Americas Kickoff North America qualifiers. A Kickoff place and a Red Bull Home Ground spot both stay within QoR's reach as a result.

The line-up of ExpMoe, calamity, vanitas, yearn and dynamic was one of eight teams Riot Games invited directly to the North America Qualifier Playoffs. Cloud9, ENVY and two Shopify Rebellion line-ups were also on that list.

Sources indicate that before facing Maryville, QoR edged Shopify Rebellion Gold 2-1 in round two. In the Swiss stage, two wins sent a team through and two losses knocked it out. QoR sit 99th in the Elo power rankings, with a rating of 1590 and a 37-34 record across 71 rated matches.

According to recent reports, maryville came through the second open qualifier, held from 12 to 15 November, which drew 512 teams. They finished in the top two of that bracket. They then opened this event by sweeping Shopify Rebellion Gold.

It has been revealed that A 0-2 loss to Cloud9 followed, and defeat by QoR left them with two losses. In the other round-three matches, Oafs beat SaD Esports, counterfeit beat FlyQuest and Wildcard beat Winthrop, each without dropping a map. The Elo table places Maryville 161st, with a rating of 1521 and a 6-7 record in 13 rated matches.

The playoffs are an eight-team double-elimination bracket. The winner takes North America’s direct place at the 2027 VCT Americas Kickoff in São Paulo. The runner-up goes to the Americas Last Chance Qualifier, also in São Paulo, on 17 and 18 December. That event is the last route into Kickoff. Eight partner teams are invited to Kickoff, and four places go to non-partner teams.

According to recent reports, riot runs the North America qualifiers with Red Bull. They also serve as the North America qualifiers for Red Bull Home Ground. The Los Angeles event runs from 10 to 13 December. Ten teams will play for a total prize pool of $100,000 USD. Eight are invited from around the world, and two earn their places through regional qualifiers. Riot will also reveal the 2027 Kickoff draws live on stage there.

Recent findings suggest that fnatic are EMEA’s invited team. The organisation is rebuilding its roster after parting with several players, including long-serving captain Jake ‘Boaster’ Howlett, Red Bull said.

10 Best Early Game Vehicles in GTA VI

📅 23 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 5 min read (1061 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Dualshockers

⏱️ ~5 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • In a recent development, vehicles can be tough to come by in the early hours of GTA 6, and it doesn’t get much easier the farther into the game you get.
  • There are a lot of good starter cars to register out there, but once you’re ready to expand, you might want something a little different.
  • Recent findings suggest that every vehicle on this list serves a good purpose and won’t run you into the ground money-wise, which is a nice bonus given your bank account problems.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

In a recent development, vehicles can be tough to come by in the early hours of GTA 6, and it doesn’t get much easier the farther into the game you get. Most every car you get has to be stolen in one way or another, especially after unlocking some upcoming personal vehicles.

There are a lot of good starter cars to register out there, but once you’re ready to expand, you might want something a little different. You won’t have an infinite amount of money, so you’ll need to be a little picky about what you want to keep.

Recent findings suggest that every vehicle on this list serves a good purpose and won’t run you into the ground money-wise, which is a nice bonus given your bank account problems. These are most of the general vehicles you can find around Port Gellhorn, although a couple are special finds.

According to recent reports, sometimes it’s nice to just have something a little fancy that’ll ride nice and easy down the streets. This Lowrider is by no means the faster or toughest car around, and it’s fairly average all around.

According to recent reports, that’s what makes it a good extra car to have, because it’s fairly decent at everything. If you get it suped up, it can get much better, but since money is tight, it’s a relatively cheap option to buy, saving you some much-needed cash.

This one is a ton of fun to drive, mostly because it’s a pretty speedy vehicle on asphalt, but not so much on dirt. That’s really what drags the car down, but still it’s a nice car that’ll get you most anywhere in a jiffy.

It has been revealed that if you’re a bit accident-prone, or prone to running into crazy NPCs, you may want to find something a bit sturdier. Still, it looks good and runs smoothly on asphalt, so it’s definitely one of the better vehicles on the road.

This car is a bit of an oddball for the area, as it’s clearly more of an upper-middle-class family car, which is not exactly what you think of in Port Gellhorn. It’s not a bad car for moving from point to point on the road or dirt.

It’s got pretty good handling and has some good size to it, making a good car for taking up space on the road. You won’t have to worry too much about getting hit with this big boy backing you up.

There are a lot of crazy looking cars on the road in GTA, but this is mostly a pretty normal-looking car. That mentioned, it still can get going on the open road without wasting too much time, so as a getaway vehicle it’s not a bad choice.

It’s on the cheaper side and seemingly pretty abundant, so getting one shouldn’t be too difficult at this point in the game. The only real issue with the vehicle is that it’s got limited handling on both dirt and asphalt.

It has been revealed that for the most part, you’re going to want a car over a bike, but when the moment for a bike comes, the Enduro is a great choice. It’s great for making a quick getaway on the road, provided you don’t crash into anything.

Sources indicate that this one handles surprisingly nicely, but since it is a bike, you’re in a much more dangerous position to get hurt in an accident. Sounds silly, but when you’re holding a bag full of goodies, it’s not fun to lose it.

This is one chunky vehicle, but in a game like this, that comes in handy. It’s not bad on any terrain, and it can get up to speed pretty quickly, making it an excellent vehicle to go on a stealing spree with.

Industry observers note that it can take a hit as good as it gives one, but its overall size might make squeezing through some tight streets a little difficult. It’s able to just move people out of the way with ease, but we all know that brings out the crazies.

While you’re mostly going to want something for the road in the early days, getting something that can do both is helpful. It’s not great on the road, but better than most, and it takes off from zero pretty swiftly.

The major concern is that road handling is terrible, and the overall speed drops off pretty swiftly; still, if you need to get off the road, this thing is great. You can even abuse it a bit since it’s a little stronger than most vehicles.

The Outlaw is one of the best and easiest-to-get vehicles in the game; while it might not be as nice as Paul Walker’s car, it does the job. Clearly a four-wheeler made for running off the road and making your own path.

It has been revealed that it’s surprisingly good on both the dirt and road, but especially in the dirt, you can basically go wherever you want. It’s a beast, especially if you’re making your way through the swampy areas. It’s a bit expensive, but well worth the price.

According to recent reports, one of the special vehicles you can find in a gang territory, this Caracara 4X4 is a phenomenal vehicle that really does it all. It’s got everything you might need in the early hours, and with some bonus strength, you can really push people around.

In a recent development, the only weak spot it has is that its asphalt handling is pretty bad, but who needs a road when you can just make your own? It’s a great car to keep Jason and Lucia happy and safe, without risking too much from either of them.

According to recent reports, another special vehicle you can steal from a gang hideout, the Firebug Dominator is an absolute godsend early on in the game. It’s got quick acceleration and some terrifying speed that’s only enhanced by the free nitro boost it comes with.

Sources indicate that if there’s any car you need to have, it’s this one, if only because it can absolutely outrun most anyone or anything. You do have to be a little careful because of the speed, or you might find yourself off the highway and in the ocean meeting the Kraken.

Battlefield 6 is getting a free trial next week with a decent selection of maps and modes

📅 13 Mar 2026 | ⏱️ 3 min read (547 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Vg247

⏱️ ~3 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Battlefield Studios has announced that Battlefield 6 is going free to play for one week next week.
  • According to recent reports, though it does not encompass the entirety of the game, the free trial is fairly generous.
  • According to recent reports, for starters, the trial kicks off Tuesday, March 17 and will run until the following Tuesday, March 24.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Battlefield Studios has announced that Battlefield 6 is going free to play for one week next week. Well, a portion of the game is, anyway, as part of a free trial that will include some of the game’s most popular modes and maps.

According to recent reports, though it does not encompass the entirety of the game, the free trial is fairly generous. Here’s what to expect.

According to recent reports, for starters, the trial kicks off Tuesday, March 17 and will run until the following Tuesday, March 24. The trial will be accessible from Battlefield Redsec, the already free-to-play portion of the game.

Once downloaded, you’ll find a latest Battlefield 6 Free Trial section in the main menu. Because Redsec and Battlefield 6 multiplayer share progression, if you played the former at any point, you’ll be able to pick up from where you left off.

The same is also true the other way around; if this is your first time with Battlefield 6, all your unlocks will carry over to the full version, as well as to Redsec if you decide stick with the free-to-play off-shoot.

Once it kicks off, you’ll find three playlists to choose from. Casual Breakthrough, All-out Warfare, and a third playlist showcasing the upcoming Nightfall game mode and its associated map.

In a recent development, all-out Warfare is what you come to Battlefield for, and that playlist features Conquest, Breakthrough, as well as BF6’s newcomer Escalation - all large-scale, combined arms game modes. They will be playable across four maps. You get to play on two from Season 2: Contaminated, and Hagental Base, one from Season 1: Eastwood, and Mirak Valley from the base game.

Casual Breakthrough is based on a playlist that already exists in the core game, and it’s really designed as a nice on-ramp for new players. It also offers less intense gameplay, perfect for people grinding unlocks.

Casual Breakthrough is limited to just 16 real players (eight per team), with the rest filled up with bots. You earn the same amount of XP in those matches, except when you interact with bots, so killing a bot will net less than a human player. Outside of that, unlocks, Challenges and all other things that don’t depend on stat-tracking can be done within.

In the trial, the Casual Breakthrough playlist includes Hagental Base, Contaminated, and Eastwood.

According to recent reports, the most interesting is the third playlist, in part because its content will also be available to owners of the full game for the first time right alongside free-to-play players. Nightfall is a playlist exclusive to the Hagental Base map.

This is a very small map, so the mode selection here is Team Deathmatch, Squad Deathmatch, and Domination. Under Nightfall conditions, lights across the entire map are turned off, so you’re going to have use your NVGs to be able to see. This is also a god opportunity to try out weapon attachments that specifically work under low-light conditions, which typically don’t get much use in multiplayer.

March 17 also marks the launch of the second stage of Battlefield 6’s Season 2, which comes with the aforementioned Nightfall content, as well as a big newly introduced enhancement - so the timing works out nicely for everyone.

💡 Key Takeaways
  • GodLike Esports beat Trigger Point Esports 2-0 in the upper bracket of the VCT Pacific Kickoff South Asia qualifier.
  • It has been revealed that godLike Esports opened their VCT Pacific Kickoff: South Asia – Qualifier 2027 playoff campaign with a 2-0 win over Trigger Point Esports on Monday 23 November 2026.
  • It has been revealed that the playoffs are being held online by Riot Games and JioBLAST.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

GodLike Esports beat Trigger Point Esports 2-0 in the upper bracket of the VCT Pacific Kickoff South Asia qualifier. Only two South Asian sides will reach the Last Chance Qualifier, where a single place at Kickoff in Bangkok is on offer.

It has been revealed that godLike Esports opened their VCT Pacific Kickoff: South Asia – Qualifier 2027 playoff campaign with a 2-0 win over Trigger Point Esports on Monday 23 November 2026. GodLike took both maps of the best-of-three upper bracket quarter-final. Trigger Point Esports now drop into the lower bracket of the double-elimination format.

It has been revealed that the playoffs are being held online by Riot Games and JioBLAST. Series in the bracket are played as best-of-three or best-of-five.

GodLike arrived in form. They reached the playoffs with an unbeaten 4-0 record in the open qualifier, VLR.gg reported. They shared joint first to fourth place in that event, which ran from 17 to 20 November. Trigger Point finished in the group placed fifth to eighth.

Recent findings suggest that godLike fielded Karam1L, Paradox and RvK from India, alongside sayoo from Indonesia and azyshaha from the Philippines. Sabyasachi ‘Antidote’ Bose is listed as head coach, with Samar as substitute. Trigger Point’s listed players are SangraM, WEELJACK and RaJ.

South Asian teams cannot qualify directly for Kickoff. The top two from the playoffs join the Oceania playoff winner and the Southeast Asia playoff runner-up in a four-team Last Chance Qualifier. Only its winner goes through to Kickoff in Bangkok, according to Dot Esports.

The stakes are high. Twelve teams will play at Kickoff, and the top three will qualify for Masters 1. The route stays narrow later in the season too. South Asia has no direct place at the Cups, with Cup 1 in Manila and Cup 2 in Tokyo. It sends two teams to an eight-team Pacific LCQ, and the winner takes the last Cup place.

Recent findings suggest that the qualifier also has a latest organiser. Riot picked JioBLAST to run the South Asia qualifiers instead of NODWIN Gaming, the previous organiser. Riot has not said why it made the change.

It has been revealed that the UK interest lies with SIGN Esports. They beat Zexar Esports 2-0 in another upper bracket quarter-final. Russel ‘Russ’ Mendes joined SIGN Esports on 16 November 2026. He is the only player from the UK in the eight-team playoff field.

According to recent reports, russ was born in 1998 and is of Indian descent. He won the VALORANT Challengers 2025 South Asia Grand Final with Velocity Gaming on 13 July 2025, when they beat S8UL 3-1.

GodLike Esports and SIGN Esports both remain in the upper bracket, one defeat away from the lower bracket. Trigger Point Esports and Zexar Esports must win from the lower bracket to stay in contention for a top-two finish. The playoffs run until 29 November 2026.

Sources indicate that A latest Honkai: Star Rail Special Program has concluded, which means some fresh news about the game’s upcoming major upgrade. Version 4.1, unveiled today as Unraveled for Daybreak, is the action RPG’s next moment, kicking off on March 25.

Unraveled for Daybreak is the next chapter in the ongoing story of Planarcadia, with the Astra Express Crew now invited to a fan fest inspired by their own past journeys. The aptly named Star Rail Fest is ostensibly hosted to allow more of the citizens of Arcadia to experience the Trailblaze.

As everyone’s eyes is fixated on the grand Star Rail Fest, the Phantasmoon Games continue to be in full swing, as does the war with the Supplicants. Star Rail Fest is, however, the big focus of this update, in case it wasn't obvious.

The event is made up of three large-scale zones, each themed around past excursions of the Astral Express. You’ll get to explore the Belobog Zone, Xianzhou Luofu Zone, and Penacony Zone. Later on, you’ll also be able to visit Pearluxe Tower, the headquarters of Pearluxe Corp.

Each area will feature its own attractions, such as the balloon figures of Supreme Guardian Cocolia and the Destruction Engine, the duel against the Lord Ravager Phantylia at Scalegorge Waterscape, and the Pearluxe Tower’s Alloy King Pom-Pom model.

Sources indicate that the hot upcoming arrival is bumbling noirish detective Ashveil whom we've met in Version 4.0, and who becomes a playable character with this enhancement. Ashveil is a 5-Star Lightning-Type character, on the Path of The Hunt. You’ll be able to pull for him throughout 4.1's runtime, which is slightly reduced at four weeks instead of the usual six, in order to rebalance the schedule after the extra-long Version 3.8.

Recent findings suggest that in combat, Ashveil is capable of increasing Crit Damage of all allies. He can also mark an enemy as Bait, which reduces the Defence of all enemies on the field so long as this tag holds. If Ashveil uses his Skill on the baited target, he will deal extra Damage and regain Skill Points for the team.

Ashveil can bully that baited target even further by launching Hounding Pursuit. If any of his teammates attacks the Bait, he can further deliver a follow-up attack that gradually accumulates Gluttony for as long as he’s in combat. Gluttony can later be consumed to boost follow-up attack damage.

Sources indicate that if he lands a kill, Ashveil continues to deal damage to the next enemy he attacks. That buff is transferred if that enemy is killed. Even in map exploration, Ashveil can be deadly, capable of inflicting Stunned upon enemies within a specific range.

Industry observers note that returning characters this patch will be Hyacine in the first half, and Boothill in the second half. Once again, due to the reduced runtime, their banner reruns will be slightly shorter than normal, at just two weeks each instead of three — so be sure to take that into account if you're planning on pulling for either of them.

In a recent development, version 4.1 also adds the Wispae War Saga, a newly introduced activity where you can practice your leadership skills by commanding different types of Wispae Soldiers in the Graphia Academy. You can upgrade each one, use spell cards to alter their effects, and later face other champions. You ultimately want to play this to unlock new Wispae Companions, not to mention complete the challenges within.

💡 Key Takeaways
  • It has been revealed that if you want to earn substantial bucks in GTA 6, you’ll want to rob banks and ATM machines.
  • Picking up marked bills and getting sprayed by dye packs will expose Jason and Lucia and make it easier for cops to notice you.
  • In order to avoid dye packs and actually claim marked bills, you must first unlock a very notable item.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

It has been revealed that if you want to earn substantial bucks in GTA 6, you’ll want to rob banks and ATM machines. However, robbing these locations will earn you marked bills, money that has been rigged with dye packs.

Picking up marked bills and getting sprayed by dye packs will expose Jason and Lucia and make it easier for cops to notice you. Additionally, dye packs completely ruin the money you just robbed, meaning you won’t be able to spend it.

In order to avoid dye packs and actually claim marked bills, you must first unlock a very notable item. Read further to learn how to avoid dye packs from marked bills in GTA 6.

Industry observers note that in order to avoid getting sprayed by dye packs when picking up marked bills in GTA 6, you must first unlock the Dye Pack Jammer. This valuable item is unlocked in Chapter 3 during the “Credit Check” mission.

Recent findings suggest that unfortunately, there is no other way to get the Dye Pack Jammer in GTA 6, meaning you just have to naturally progress the story until it becomes available. The good news is that it's unmissable.

It has been revealed that credit Check is the 16th mission in Chapter 3, so it’s pretty far along in the game. For reference, it took me about 30 hours to reach this point. Granted, I have been exploring the world thoroughly and completing side objectives, so how long it takes you to reach this mission depends on your playstyle.

According to recent reports, during Credit Check, you’ll meet Raul’s group of thieves who are planning a huge bank heist. One of his companions gives you the Dye Pack Jammer to prepare you for the heist.

According to recent reports, the Dye Pack Jammer is automatically equipped when you unlock it in Chapter 3. In other words, you don’t have to manually equip it or anything.

Industry observers note that the Dye Pack Jammer allows you to rob any bank in Leonida, as well as towable ATM machines, without worrying that you’ll get sprayed by pink dye. However, the marked bills you earn from these locations aren’t available to use right away.

In order to turn marked bills into money you can spend, you must bring them to one of the Fence NPCs. Each Fence offers money for marked bills, but Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. You will unlock Yasmani after completing the main story “Boobie Time” in Chapter 3.

If you haven’t claimed the Dye Pack Jammer yet and happened to get covered in dye, then Jason and Lucia will remain exposed to the cops, making exploration and committing robberies much harder. It’s for this reason that you want to remove the dye from your clothes and body as soon as possible.

Recent findings suggest that there are a couple of ways to remove the dye from your characters. First, you can go back to your apartment, take a shower, and change your clothes to remove the dye. Besides that, you can simply wait until it goes away, which takes a long time, or force yourself to get Wasted or Busted.

Konami has provided zero indication that it plans to bring any Silent Hill games to the Switch 2, so while we wallow in despair, we can at least take comfort in the knowledge that something remarkably similar is on the way.

According to recent reports, revealed at The Horror Game Awards 2026, Ugly Within is published by Serafini Productions and confirmed for Switch 2, PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC. There's no release date as of yet, but judging from the quality of the trailer, it seems development is proceeding well.

Industry observers note that featuring a familiar over-the-shoulder viewpoint, Ugly Within sees you take on the roles of Shu Onodera and Reiko Miyama as they investigate the mysterious Kamata estate. The former utilises stealth abilities to slip by monsters unseen, while the latter confronts them head-on via exorcism.

It has been revealed that the trailer is unsettling, to say the least, and the production value seems high. There's one sequence in which a woman's face just peels open to reveal a bulging eye surrounded by teeth, and it's proper gross.

Let's check out the key features:.

- See the Past: Use Shu's ability to read the echoes left in rooms and objects, uncovering clues from the past to solve present-day mysteries.

- Two Protagonists: Switch between stealth, quiet exploration and puzzle-solving as Shu and direct confrontation and exorcism as Reiko.

- Secluded Estate: Explore a traditional Japanese house filled with dim corridors, tatami rooms and hidden underground spaces, each holding a piece of the Kamata family's story.

- Survival Under Pressure: Follow the records and traces others left behind, manage limited resources and find a way to survive what the family has been hiding.

Recent findings suggest that so yes, while we continue to lament the lack of Silent Hill on Switch 2, we'll keep a close eye on Ugly Within in the coming weeks and months. It looks neat, and hopefully it'll prove a worthy alternative upon release.

Casualties: Unknown is a total pain simulator that makes other survival games seem like massive cowards
